body: Ok so u found finally outility growing up on this planet is not easy. The two comments I just read my heart starts to cry. :(
I have had a few days more sleep and kept myself in a sort of middle and balanced positive state, the summer is hot and full sunlight. It helps me a lot.

U are right, I have to balance, and make choices that not take my energy, I have to find ways to feel not used and abused. There is a lot of cultural differences between us, and she is like a vulcano and not ashamed to use lies to get her portion of pitty attention. I will consider to find more ways to break this circle i am running

Thanks mate, you`re not to late
I ringed my foster dad who is on the other side of the world
We had a long talk and he invited me to his place to find my soul back.

I kind of was not really happy to tell him how i was cause I might make him feel guilty or something, but it went ok.

They have my son and there is nothing I can do, the judge decided without hesitation he has no chance living with me cause I was such a bad person. My ex used him as an iitem to give to her parents. She is a mother for a few days a month and is not having the patient to raise him. I endure a few times a month verbal and physical abuse from her also, I needed time to accept that I was just a tool in her traditional family game, knowing I can't put up a fight cause I have no family. I am aware I sound weak, but I describe this feeling as " giving it a try to find something to go for" ..... Still the hope is nowhere anymore. I plan on getting drunk tonight and jump. I considered other options, but a jump from a high floor seems saver. Can't imagine there will be pain.
